entries.3c9e1c6cda210460: Its management philosophy is 'Chōetsu', aiming to provide products and services that connect people and technology and offer emotion and joy that exceed satisfaction. As medium- to long-term strategy, the Game Business is extending its scope from planning and development to supporting domains in which creators can focus on development and distribute their works domestically and overseas. The Mobile Business aims to raise the earning power of its stores through in-store support that offers reassurance and a store visit experience, and pursues new store-operation business opportunities that make use of the know-how and personnel cultivated in store operations. The medium-term management plan (from the fiscal year ended June 2025 to the fiscal year ended June 2027) positions strengthening business earning power and improving the return on invested capital as its medium- to long-term management issues.

entries.598b4315724539cb: The main customers of the Game Business are game companies such as Bandai Namco Entertainment, SNK, GungHo Online Entertainment and Nintendo, while customers of the Mobile Business are individuals who purchase devices and sign up for services at stores.
entries.6c899fa997962629: In the game industry, long-running titles secure stable revenue, while competition for new titles is intense; in contracted development, budget sizes are expanding and titles are being selected more carefully. As a mid-sized contract development and operation group, the company is in a position where its ability to assemble people and teams capable of handling increasingly large development projects is being tested. In the Mobile Business, the market is maturing as device prices rise and replacement demand has run its course, and it is positioned as a sales agent that seeks to differentiate itself through the experiential value of physical stores.
